address: 201, Building No.1, WYSH, 168 Wuyi Road, Changning, Shanghai, Chinese Mainland
bio: Nabi is Korean for "butterfly", symbolising here the exciting metamorphosis of traditional Korean fare under the young chef-owner's stewardship. In the jet-coloured room, which is theatrically lit and dotted with butterfly motifs, the 17-seat counter encloses an open kitchen. Inventive techniques capture Korean flavours, in modern, meticulously plated dishes. There is just one menu and this changes from time to time.
